bio.text: Steve Scalise represents Louisiana's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, to which he was elected in 2008 after serving in the Louisiana Legislature from 1996 to 2008.
He has been House Majority Leader in the 118th and 119th Congresses, and previously served as Majority Whip from 2014 to 2018 and Minority Whip from 2019 to 2022.
A native of Jefferson Parish, he graduated from Louisiana State University with a degree in computer science.
